### BioHorizons brings metal-free dental implant solution to U.S.


11/02/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 164 KB](https://s21.q4cdn.com/686911487/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/02/Press-Release_CERALOG_US_launch_2026-November.pdf)


*The entire system is metal-free, providing an alternative to traditional titanium implant systems.*


**BIRMINGHAM, Ala. — Nov. 2, 2026** — BioHorizons has introduced CERALOG® PROGRESSIVE-LINE implants to the U.S. market, a ceramic dental implant that is completely metal-free.


While most dental implants are made of titanium, some patients require an alternative. The introduction of CERALOG to the U.S. market allows doctors to meet the needs of more patients with a metal-free solution. When treatment calls for an alternative implant treatment solution, CERALOG provides the esthetics, stability and reliability a doctor needs for their workflow.


Key features include:


- **Fully metal-free solution:** Ceramic implant, zirconia/PEEK restorative components and metal-free screw
- **Two-piece restorative flexibility:** Provides restorative options beyond those available with traditional one-piece ceramic implant designs
- **Bolt-in-tube implant-abutment connection:** Engineered to provide a stable, precise connection between the ceramic implant and restorative component
- **High-performance ceramic material:** Designed to provide the mechanical performance required for implant dentistry while delivering the esthetic benefits of a tooth-colored material


CERALOG merges a modern implant body design with completely metal-free restorative components to address the growing U.S. market for alternative implant solutions,” said BioHorizons President & CEO Steve Boggan. “This new addition to our already broad implant product portfolio allows us to provide doctors with an even broader range of solutions for their patients.”


Originally developed by partner company Camlog, CERALOG features a modern tapered, aggressive thread design and dedicated surgical instrumentation. By launching in the U.S., CERALOG expands the availability of metal-free implant treatment options.


Visit biohorizons.com for more product details.


*Attachments: Logo, Product image*


**


**About BioHorizons**


BioHorizons is one of the largest dental implant companies in the world. Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, the company has demonstrated its commitment to developing evidence-based and scientifically proven products since 1994.


BioHorizons offers dental implant treatment providers around the world a comprehensive portfolio of solutions based on a strong foundation of science, innovation and service. This portfolio includes dental implants, prosthetics, biomaterials and digital solutions – everything a clinician needs to provide tooth replacement therapy. The BioHorizons Digital Ecosystem ensures the company is there to support customers throughout the entire treatment process – from planning and scanning to surgery and through to restoration – all with the support of a highly trained Customer Care team.


BioHorizons helps dental specialists and dentists restore smiles all over the world.
